description: The dex.json document written by nar-dex (root case document and per-case cache copy share this shape). Two shapes exist, versioned by the top-level dex_format field (3.0 Part 11): ABSENT means the full 2.6.2 shape — classes carry per-method objects {name, kind, native, access_flags} and per-field objects {name, type, kind}, and call_edges are objects {from_class, from_method, to_class, to_method, kind}. dex_format = 'compact' (the nar-dex default since 3.0; --full restores the full shape exactly) means each parsed dex_files entry additionally carries method_table {classes, names, ids} (the method-id table stored once: parallel class/name string tables plus [class_idx, name_idx, shorty] rows), class methods are [method_idx, access_flags, kind] index rows into that table, fields are [name, type, kind] rows, invoke_kinds is the per-DEX invoke-kind legend, and call_edges are [from_method_idx, to_method_idx, kind_idx] rows. Both shapes validate against this schema; narlib.dex expand_dex_classes / expand_call_edges read both identically. A dex_files entry that failed to parse carries {name, error} instead of the analysis fields. Targets that are compiled artifacts (OAT/VDEX/ODEX/ART) add a compiled_artifact object.

call_edges.description: Full shape: objects {from_class, from_method, to_class, to_method, kind}. Compact shape: [from_method_idx, to_method_idx, kind_idx] rows over method_table + invoke_kinds.

classes.description: Class entries {class, superclass, interfaces, methods, fields}. Full shape: methods/fields are objects. Compact shape: methods are [method_idx, access_flags, kind] rows, fields are [name, type, kind] rows.

invoke_kinds.description: Compact shape only: the invoke-kind legend call_edges kind_idx values index into.

method_table.description: Compact shape only: the method-id table stored once — {classes: [descriptors], names: [method names], ids: [[class_idx, name_idx, shorty], ...]}, one ids row per method id, in method-index order.

dex_format.description: Shape marker (3.0 Part 11): 'compact' for the compact shape; absent for the full 2.6.2 shape (every pre-3.0 document and every --full document).

title: NAR DEX analysis
